csv_project_name: PM for Los Gatos Capital Improvement Program
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Los Gatos, CA is seeking a qualified firm to provide program and project management services to support our Capital Improvement Program (CIP). The consultant will manage the entire CIP and coordinate all aspects of project delivery under the leadership of the Town Engineer. The selected firm will provide experienced personnel to assist with the planning, design, and implementation of various capital projects. This includes, but is not limited to, infrastructure improvements, public facilities upgrades, and other municipal projects. The goal is to ensure that all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and compliance
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering
